title: File verification for the Sintel wall recreation
provenance: Sintel (Blender open movie), 1080p master frame 7280, copied byte-for-byte from the public media.xiph.org mirror. License CC BY 3.0 with the required attribution, verbatim: Sintel © Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org
production: The 3D scene is a production recreation, not an end-to-end pipeline output: the character was generated with Meshy image-to-3D from crops of the source frame, the environment (wall, brick tower, leaning beams, birds, crenellations, sky) was built procedurally in Blender, the out-of-focus mid-ground object was rebuilt from its readable silhouette (species not identified and not claimed to be a dragon), and the composition was refined interactively with Astra assistance.

input_frame.note: Source frame copied unmodified; the pixels are a byte copy of the survey pick from the media.xiph.org mirror.

preview_image.note: Hero render used as the catalog card preview.

central_object: The central mid-ground object is out of focus in the source frame and its species is unidentifiable; it was rebuilt from its readable silhouette; species not identified and not claimed to be a dragon. Earlier interpretations of this object that added subjects absent from the frame were removed on source-fidelity grounds.
background: The scene contains only what the source frame shows: the girl from behind on the wall top, the out-of-focus mid-ground object beside her, the brick tower with leaning beams at the right edge, birds, crenellations, and the frame's empty golden sunset sky. Nothing was added to the background.

verification.summary: A fresh Blender 5.2.1 LTS process reopened the saved scene file for verification: all textures are packed inline with no missing external images, and the exported web GLB was reimported and verified in a fresh Blender process.

camera_note: The GLB embeds one camera, an eye-aligned build camera used while composing the scene; it is not a verified source-image camera. The catalog camera field is null and the viewer's reset returns to the default view.
validation_limits: Visual acceptance of the published web render is still pending human review; the recorded verification covers the Blender reopen, texture packing, and the GLB reimport.
Meshy usage is recorded as credits (4 tasks) in the private build session, not USD; cost_usd is null.
The original high-poly build evidence is retained in the private build session, not in this repository.
